adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Chronic prednisone suppresses bone formation through reduced osteoblast function and survival plus osteoblast/osteocyte apoptosis, producing glucocorticoid-induced osteoporosis.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Glucocorticoids also increase bone resorption early and decrease calcium absorption. The lead asks specifically about chronic reduction in bone formation, making reduced osteoblast activity/survival uniquely responsive.
